name: 1099 Contractor Starter
description: For freelancers and independent contractors whose clients don't withhold tax. Adds business and tax categories and suggests setting aside 25% of each month's income for quarterly estimated taxes (federal due dates are generally Apr 15, Jun 15, Sep 15 and Jan 15). 25% is a starting point, not tax advice: your rate depends on your income, deductions and state, so adjust it on the Budget screen.
author: Rayven J. Moore, CPA
